purpose: Scaled retrieval diagnostic with distractors; not end-to-end LLM accuracy

splits.dev: cases used for first-period reporting and spot checks
splits.holdout: reserved; do not tune retrieval parameters against this split before first scored run

scoring: top1_distractor_rate when top metadata is non-executable
example_hit_at_2 for mode-matched few-shots when expected_mode set
notes: Independent from hr-query-v1 / modes task scores
Hit@K must not be reported as ask-success rate
